summary: Two out-of-state brothers became lost near Bierstadt Lake in Rocky Mountain National Park after a 10:30 p.m. Monday call on a poor cell connection; lost due to snow-packed trails and darkness; RMNP SAR team members reached the pair at 1 a.m. Tuesday; snowing, men cold and wet, unprepared to spend the night; no injuries reported
location: Bierstadt Lake, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue
notes: NPS news release 2017-04-26 (opened run 137). Recorded at the missing/search date per the Stehling-row convention. RMNP east side; county Larimer.
